newsitem.title: UK: Unilever shares firm on presentations. [CORRECTED 14:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Unilever shares firm on presentations. [CORRECTED 14:30 GMT]

text.p: Shares in consumer products group Unilever Plc were one of the biggest movers in a generally firm market (corrects from "were firm in an otherwise flat market") on Thursday, helped by what analysts called an upbeat series of presentations on the company's outlook in the U.S.
"There have been a number of presentations which appear to point towards solid growth coming in faster than expected," said one analyst who asked not to be named.
Unilever UK shares were up 20p at 1,362-1/2p at 1331 GMT, just off their intraday high of 1,365p.
"We've seen quite healthy interest in this stock today," said one marketmaker.
